title: CAN Receive
text: Receive CAN messages from specified CAN device, 2 outputs, {Standard IDs Filter} sets Limit or; {Device} sets the cAN device and channel, {Extended IDs Filter} limits or allow messages based on extended ID Allow, {Sample time} sets the block execution rate, {Number of messages received at each timestep} sets the receive one and {Output as bus} sets the output Simulink bus signal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device
params.values: CAN device and channel list option

params.name: Standard IDs Filter
params.values: Limit or allow messages based on standard ID Allow all (default) | Allow only | Block all

params.name: Extended IDs Filter
params.values: Limit or allow messages based on extended ID Allow all (default) | Allow only | Block all

params.name: Number of messages received at each timestep
params.values: Receive one or all messages all (default) | 1

params.name: Output as bus
params.values: Output Simulink bus signal off (default) | on
